description: Two-handed elemental melee - weaves Runeblade with elemental weapon strikes (Smolder, Fracture, Hoarfrost, Hurricane) and cooldown detonations.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers (Smolder, Hoarfrost, Ice Rune confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Primordial Blast/Smolder refresh Runeblade charges, every third Runeblade cast pays back resources and hits harder via Runic Omen/Surging Slash.

nodes.name: Elemental Assassin
nodes.description: Increases spell damage, spell critical strike chance, and hit rating scaling from Agility by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Tempo
nodes.description: Increases Runeblade damage by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Swift Etching
nodes.description: Increases melee attack speed and critical strike chance by 1% per rank. Once Hurricane has finished striking, your runes stay sharp: Haste is increased by 15% and physical critical strike chance by 10% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA Riftblade tooltip: 'After Hurricane ends, your melee attack speed is increased by 15% and critical strike chance by 10% for 10 seconds.' The sidekick solo rotation names it directly - 'Keep Hurricane rolling for its multi-strike and the Swift Etching haste/crit window after it ends' - so this is Riftblade's node and Riftblade's trigger. The node previously carried only the flat stat half, which is why a copy of the Hurricane window had been authored in the Engravement tree, where Hurricane is unobtainable. The flat half is kept so the node is never dead before Hurricane is taken, and the window is the real mechanic on top. Hurricane runs a 6-turn cooldown, so a 2-turn window is roughly CoA's uptime.

nodes.name: Mana Ward
nodes.description: Increases maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Frost Spectre
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Smolder and Primordial Blast by 3% per rank, and your Frost damage by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Augur's Shield
nodes.description: Learn Augur's Shield, regenerating Mana and reducing damage taken for a duration.

nodes.name: Frost Blade
nodes.description: Learn Frost Blade, dealing Frost damage and generating a Frost Sigil.

nodes.name: Fire Blade
nodes.description: Learn Fire Blade, dealing Fire damage and generating a Fire Sigil.

nodes.name: Smolder
nodes.description: Learn Smolder, igniting your blade to strike an enemy for Fire damage.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 18, Riftblade(1), '140% Weapon Damage plus 37 Fire Damage.'

nodes.name: Fracture
nodes.description: Learn Fracture, dealing Frost damage and burning the target's mana. Guaranteed critical against Frozen targets.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Fracture - Frost damage + burns target's mana. Guaranteed crit vs. Frozen targets.'

nodes.name: Hoarfrost
nodes.description: Learn Hoarfrost, a frontal cleave that deals Frost damage now and over time, freezing enemies hit.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: Lvl 24, Riftblade(1), '42 Frost Damage to up to 3 nearby enemies, plus an additional 42 every 3 sec for 21 sec. Enemies hit by the initial strike are frozen in place for 3 sec.'

nodes.name: Hurricane
nodes.description: Learn Hurricane, a multi-strike Nature channel.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Hurricane (multi-strike Nature channel).' Keep Hurricane rolling for its multi-strike + Swift Etching's haste/crit window after it ends.

nodes.name: Echo Rune
nodes.description: Learn Echo Rune, marking your location so you can warp back and heal when it expires or is reactivated.

nodes.name: Genesis
nodes.description: Learn Genesis, branding an enemy to bank a percentage of your damage, unleashing it as Elemental damage after a delay.

nodes.name: Turbulence
nodes.description: Learn Turbulence, dropping a Nature-damage AoE zone.

nodes.name: Primordial Fury
nodes.description: A burst cooldown that flares your Runic Tattoo to cleave extra enemies and pumps Runeblade.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Riftblade's burst capstone alongside Zenith: 'flares runic tattoos to cleave extra enemies + pump Runeblade.'

nodes.name: Magebreaker
nodes.description: Hurricane has a 10% chance per rank to break the magic coiled around you, reducing Magic damage taken by 15% for 3 turns.

nodes.name: Runic Omen
nodes.description: Runeblade has a 20% chance per rank to call a runic omen, dealing 25% extra damage and granting 1 Rune.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'every third Runeblade restores resources + hits harder via Runic Omen/Surging Slash.' This spec's core resource-return identity.

nodes.name: Windsage
nodes.description: Smolder wraps you in wind for 3 turns. While Windsage holds, every Runeblade strikes an extra time.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Smolder wraps you in wind: next 3 Runeblades strike an extra time (Nature damage, % of damage dealt).'

nodes.name: Spellfire Runes
nodes.description: Runeblade has a 12% chance per rank to ignite your blade, striking with a free Smolder. Cannot occur more than once per turn.

nodes.name: Surging Slash
nodes.description: Runeblade surges with stored rune power, increasing your damage done by 20% for 2 turns. Cannot occur more than once every 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Every 3rd Runeblade transforms next Runeblade into Surging Slash.'

nodes.name: Aspect of the Rune Knight
nodes.description: Reduces damage taken and increases maximum Mana. Only one Aspect active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces damage taken; boosts max mana. One Aspect active.'

nodes.name: Ley Power
nodes.description: Increases your damage per nearby enemy, up to a cap, and increases melee/spell haste while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, Riftblade Strengths writeup: 'Turbulence's AoE zone pays for being surrounded' - Ley Power is the same shared mechanic seen in Engravement.

nodes.name: Pierce Resistances
nodes.description: Your runes bite past elemental wards, increasing your Arcane, Fire, Frost and Nature damage by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Elder Magi Rune
nodes.description: Learn Elder Magi Rune, dealing Arcane damage to nearby enemies and increasing the target's Arcane damage taken.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Nearby Arcane damage; boosts target's Arcane damage taken.'

nodes.name: Elemental Inscription
nodes.description: Every Smolder you land scrapes a turn off Primordial Fury's cooldown, and grants you 1 Rune.
nodes._source: CoA Riftblade tooltip, 23 TE - the tree's own top gate: 'Casting Smolder now reduces the cooldown of Primordial Fury by -10 sec and Zenith by -5 sec.' REPLACES Prismatic Knight, which has no counterpart anywhere in CoA's Runemaster data (class tree or any of the three spec trees) and contradicted the spec page's stated weakness that Riftblade has no passive mitigation. CoA's six 23-TE Riftblade nodes are Turbulence, Fracture, Genesis, Spellfire Runes, Waveforged and Elemental Inscription; the first four already sit lower in this tree and Waveforged keys off Runeshroud, which this engine does not model, so Elemental Inscription is the one real top-gate node that was both missing and expressible. The Zenith half is deliberately dropped: Zenith is granted only by the Engravement tree here, so naming it would rebuild the same cross-tree dead filter this pass removed. The Rune is the Frontier stand-in for the second cooldown it cut in CoA.

nodes.name: Melting Runes
nodes.description: Increases your Fire and Frost damage by 5% per rank. Hoarfrost melts what it touches, reducing the Armor of enemies it strikes by 40 for 3 turns.

nodes.name: Ice Rune
nodes.description: Learn Ice Rune, freezing an enemy via a stun. Requires the target already be Frozen.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, 'Requires Frozen Target. Unleash a frost rune at an enemy, stunning them for 4 sec. Affected enemies are considered Frozen.'

nodes.name: Runecarve
nodes.description: Clear your active Sigils. Doesn't break Runeshroud.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Clears active Sigils. Doesn't break Runeshroud.' Utility reset tool.

nodes.name: Runic Power
nodes.description: Grants the party a damage buff, and your critical strikes increase the target's chance to be critically struck. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage buff (no stacking with similar); crits boost target's crit-taken chance.'

nodes.name: Runic Knowledge
nodes.description: Increases spell power scaling from Intellect by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Rift Resonance
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
